description: The plot illustrates the comparison of the Macro-F1 Score (%) against the Number of tokens for two different configurations. The x-axis is labeled "Number of tokens" and features a linear scale ranging from 0.5 to 1.5, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 0.2 from 0.6 to 1.4. The y-axis is labeled "Macro-F1 Score (%)" and uses a linear scale with values ranging from approximately 47 to 59, featuring tick marks at intervals of 2 from 48 to 58. The line representing "MATTER (ours)" is depicted as a solid pink line with solid circular markers and a shaded variance band. It begins at an x-value of 0.5 with a y-value of approximately 55.1, dips slightly to 54.3 at x=0.7, and then rises to a local peak of 57.0 at x=0.8. After a slight drop to 56.3 at x=0.9, it reaches its highest peak of approximately 57.9 at x=1.0. The line then exhibits a declining trend down to 52.6 at x=1.3, rises briefly to 53.5 at x=1.4, and concludes with a sharp drop to approximately 50.9 at x=1.5. The line representing "w/o material information" is shown as a solid purple line with solid circular markers and a shaded variance band. It starts at x=0.5 with a y-value of approximately 52.5, remains relatively steady to 52.6 at x=0.6, and then rises to a peak of 54.1 at x=0.7. The line then drops to 53.3 at x=0.8, remains flat at 53.3 at x=0.9, and gradually declines to 51.7 at x=1.3. It experiences a brief rise to 53.3 at x=1.4 before dropping sharply to end at approximately 47.9 at x=1.5.
